influences.name: Motown and Stax
influences.context: "I was a sort of Motown and Stax specialist when I was a studio musician, and I brought that groove into Led Zeppelin"

influences.name: R&B
influences.context: "Bonzo was also a big R&B fan, so there's a lot of it in the Zeppelin rhythm section."

influences.name: B. B. King
influences.context: I learned a lot from B. B. King, Otis Rush, and Buddy Guy: I used to listen to their records over and over, and then try to play exactly like that
